items.note: Nomination 31 Oct, early voting 10 Nov, campaign ends 23:59 Fri 13 Nov. BN (UMNO-led, CM Ab Rauf Yusoh) contests 23 seats and its ally PN (PAS-led) 5. PH contests 24, Bersatu 7 (no formal pact with PH). BN won 21 of 28 in 2021. Before dissolution: BN 20, PH 5, PN 3. No published vote-share poll found; Ilham Centre says about 13% undecided, mostly Gen Z (NST 9 Nov). BN targets up to 26 seats; PH aims to hold its five and reach 18. Assembly dissolved 23 Sep; PN registration cancelled by RoS on 20 Oct but suspended by the court until after the vote.

items.note: Adds time and detail to the existing 15 Nov items. ČTK 12 Nov: organisers say it 'may be the largest civic gathering in the country's history' (they put spring 2026 Letná at up to 250,000). At least 60 regional buses are coming, and many Sunday trains and coaches to Prague are sold out. DPP will run more frequent metro about 11:30-19:00 and temporary tram lines 40 (12:00-19:00) and 44 (12:00-14:30). Police expect no trouble; the ambulance service is reinforced. The rally is billed as peaceful. The title refers to the 04:36 Saturday 24 Oct vote on the fee-abolition bill. Confirmed on milionchvilek.cz: 'Neděle 15. listopadu od 14:00'.

items.title: CORRECTION: ČEZ has issued its 2027 open-ended price lists: power energy +3.5%, gas +6.5% from 1 January
items.title_cs: CORRECTION: ČEZ už zveřejnil ceníky na rok 2027: silová elektřina +3,5 %, plyn +6,5 % od 1. ledna
items.note: Corrects the agenda line that no supplier had issued 2027 lists (true at 22 Oct). Effective 1 Jan 2027. Power up about 330 CZK/MWh, gas about 180 CZK/MWh; D02d at 4,190 CZK/MWh incl. VAT (Seznam Zprávy, clanek 319315). D02d 2 MWh about +660 CZK a year, gas 12 MWh about +1,800 CZK a year incl. VAT; standing fee unchanged. Regulated part comes on top, ERÚ final at end of November. Reported by TZB-info 4 Nov. E.ON and PRE 2027 open-ended lists not found. Innogy raised its offers for new customers and renewals (power +400 CZK/MWh, standing fee 135 CZK/MWh, new-contract discount cut from 20% to 11% from 1 Nov); Centropol gas fixed offers up 170 CZK/MWh. Those are not January list changes.

Eisenkot rules out governing with the Arab-led parties; UTJ+Shas would give exactly 61. Supersedes the 13 Nov item ('consultations, no mandate').

items.title: Context/CORRECTION: Chamber media committee adjourned its debate on the fee-abolition bill until 10 December

Per the ČT24 homepage (30 Oct) headline 'Debatu o rušení poplatků pro ČT a ČRo přerušil sněmovní výbor do prosince', the committee resumes on 10 Dec. A second-reading vote on the fee bill in the 3–13 Nov window is therefore unlikely.
